personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 4 Tactile color warmth
personality_one_liner: A premium, trustworthy, and warm 'Ownership OS' that makes managing receipts and warranties feel like magic through ultra-smooth micro-animations, cream/mint palettes, and sophisticated typography.

spacing.rule: Adopt an 8px base rhythm (Revolut/Linear style). Use generous padding (lg/xl) around main content to let the UI breathe. Tightly group related metadata.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar where the center scan button floats.
Use glass headers over scrolling lists in 'My Stuff' and 'Return Center'.
dont's: Do not apply glass to body cards (receipts, items). Keep them as clean, solid surfaceSecondary.
Do not over-blur the background to the point of losing contrast.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A dashboard overview showing immediate actions and summary data.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders mimicking the horizontal 'Act Now' cards and item list.
states.empty: Custom SVG illustration of a neat desk with a 'Scan your first receipt' CTA.

screens.layout: Search-first top area. Followed by a horizontal scroll of 'Act now' cards (expiring warranties, return windows). A central floating '+' or 'Scan' button sits in the bottom tab navigation. Use 9999px pill radii for tags.

screens.name: Scan Camera & AI Processing
screens.purpose: Capture flow for receipts with real-time feedback.

states.loading: Step-by-step animated states: Fiş okunuyor → Mağaza bulundu → Ürünler tanınıyor → İade kontrolü → Garanti
states.error: Clear manual review fallback with large, tappable fields for critical data.

screens.layout: Edge-detection camera view with a rounded receipt frame overlay and moving light animation. Post-capture, present a success screen with a confetti micro-animation and checkmark.

screens.name: My Stuff (Eşyalarım)

states.empty: Custom minimal SVG illustration of an empty shelf. Primary CTA to add an item.

screens.layout: Sticky top bar with grid/list view toggle and category chip filters (Electronics, Fashion, etc., using pastel category colors). Cards use surfaceSecondary on the surface background.

screens.name: Product Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific item's lifecycle, warranty, and return info.
screens.layout: Hero image at the top with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Includes a dynamic countdown ring for return windows and a vertical timeline of the product's lifecycle (Purchase -> Return Deadline -> Warranty Expiry).

screens.name: Return & Warranty Center
screens.purpose: Dedicated tabs for managing items based on their status.

states.empty: Custom SVG illustration representing 'All good, no expiring items'.

screens.layout: Tabbed interface (Active / Ending soon / Expired) using pill-shaped segmented controls. Display AI verdicts for return details.

screens.name: AI Assistant
screens.purpose: Chat interface for quick actions and ownership queries.

states.empty: Welcome message with suggested quick action chips.

screens.layout: Conversational UI with quick action pills at the bottom, above the input field. Floating date headers in the scroll view.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the SAKLIO SOFT (Main) and SAKLIO DARK exact hex codes provided in the user prompt. Use the pastel tokens for category chips (e.g., Electronics, Fashion).
Ensure all skeleton loaders are implemented using `react-native-reanimated`. Do NOT use standard ActivityIndicator spinners per user requirements.
The UI is in Turkish. Use terms like 'Ana Sayfa', 'Eşyalarım', 'Aktiviteler', 'Profil' for tabs.
Build a custom 'Scan' center button for the bottom tab bar. It should be circular, floating slightly above the bar, triggering the heavy haptic.

Implement micro-animations on all interactive elements: buttons should scale down slightly on press (0.97 scale), list items should stagger animate on entry, and the 'AI Processing' step-by-step should transition smoothly.

Since custom SVG illustrations are required for empty states, generate custom placeholder SVGs mimicking a 'rounded, soft, minimal, slightly 3D layered, thin outlines' style, or use placeholder `<Svg>` structures that reflect this requirement.
Typography must be Inter, employing a hierarchy based on the provided scale: Display 32-36, Page Title 26, Section 20, Card 16-18, Body 14-16. Use tabular numerals for prices and countdowns.
In the Product Detail screen, implement the 'countdown ring for return' and 'lifecycle timeline' natively using SVG/Reanimated for smooth rendering.
